papers.title: Stepping up recovery: integrating patient reported outcome measures and wearable technology for 90-day rehabilitation following total hip arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Cleveland Clinic Foundation, Cleveland, OH, 44195, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Nicolás S. Piuzzi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Cleveland Clinic, Orthopedic and Rheumatology Institute, 9500 Euclid Ave, A41, Cleveland, OH, 44195, USA. piuzzin@ccf.org

papers.venue: Archives of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向无关，该文章关注全髋关节置换术后康复，未涉及生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical metrics of the femoral stem; it is purely a clinical rehabilitation study without finite element modeling or implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估患者报告结局指标与可穿戴设备在髋关节置换术后康复中的整合应用。
summary_zh.method: 对患者术后90天进行可穿戴设备监测和PROMs评估。
summary_zh.result: 显示活动水平与患者报告结局之间的相关性，证实可行性。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the integration of patient-reported outcome measures and wearable technology in post-total hip arthroplasty rehabilitation.
summary_en.method: A clinical study using wearable devices and PROMs to monitor recovery over 90 days following surgery.
summary_en.result: The study demonstrated feasibility and significant correlations between physical activity metrics and patient-reported outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through a clinical cohort study with 90-day follow-up.

papers.title: Hormone Replacement Therapy in Postmenopausal Women Undergoing Total Hip Arthroplasty is Associated With Reduced 10-Year Periprosthetic Femoral Fracture Rate
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, Maryland

corresponding_authors.name: Amy Zhao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, Maryland

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文是临床流行病学研究，完全不涉及髋关节植入物的生物力学建模或接触力学。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding analysis, no implant design or FEA; purely clinical outcomes.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨激素替代疗法对全髋关节置换术后假体周围骨折风险的影响。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列分析，比较接受与未接受激素替代疗法的患者10年骨折率。
summary_zh.result: 激素替代疗法与较低的假体周围骨折率相关。
summary_zh.validation: 多变量回归调整混杂因素，基于注册数据。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether hormone replacement therapy reduces periprosthetic femoral fracture risk after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective cohort study using registry data, comparing fracture rates between HRT users and non-users over 10 years.
summary_en.result: HRT was associated with a significantly lower 10-year periprosthetic fracture rate.
summary_en.validation: Multivariable regression analysis adjusting for demographic and surgical covariates.
